In addition, it operates and manages hotel under the Pathikashram name; and provides finance and real estate services, as well as operates a retail petroleum outlet in Gujarat, India.

ARCHIES.NS.d: Archies Limited, a social expressions company, deals in greeting cards, gifts, and stationery products under the Archies brand name in India. It offers fashion accessories, such as men and women accessories, watches, wallets, keychains, cufflinks, bags, sun glasses, and gift sets; combos and hampers; home decor products, including statues and sculptures, desk accessories, photo frames, idols, quotations and scrolls, clocks, cushions, show pieces, wall hanging products, and lamps and lanterns; and earrings, neck…

ASIANHOTNR.NS.d: Asian Hotels (North) Limited engages in hospitality/hotel business in India. The company owns and operates Hyatt Regency Delhi, a five-star deluxe hotel, which includes 507 rooms and suites, spa, unisex salon, fitness center, restaurant, bar, and outdoor swimming pool in New Delhi. It also operates two wind turbine generators in Maharashtra. In addition, the company provides offshore project consultancy services; and develops villa hotel complex, including residential villas and golf course in Goa.

AVROIND.NS.d: Avro India Limited is an Indian company that makes and sells plastic-molded furnishings and granular plastic raw materials. Its products include chairs, stools, tables and children's chairs and desks, retailed under the AVON FURNITURE and AVRO FURNITURE brands. It was established in 1996.

BANCOINDIA.NS.d: Banco Products (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells automobile components for OEM markets in India and internationally.

BCG.NS.d: Brightcom Group Limited provides digital marketing solutions to businesses, agencies, and online publishers worldwide. It operates through Digital Marketing and Software Development segments. The company connects advertisers with their audience across various forms of digital media to deliver messages to the right audience. The company was formerly known as Lycos Internet Limited and changed its name to Brightcom Group Limited in September 2018.

BHARTIHEXA.NS.d: Bharti Hexacom Limited provides consumer mobile, fixed-line telephone and broadband services in India under the Airtel brand. Its portfolio includes pre-paid and post-paid wireless voice, data communication, international roaming, landline telephony and high-speed internet.

CRISIL.NS.d: CRISIL Limited, an analytical company, together with its subsidiaries, provides ratings, data, research, and analytics and solutions in India, Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Ratings, Research, and Advisory. The Ratings services segment offers credit ratings for corporates, banks, bank loans, and small and medium enterprises; credit analysis services; grading services; and analytical services.

DHABRIYA.NS.d: Dhabriya Polywood Limited manufactures and sells PVC profiles and products in India. They offer a range of products used in interior and exterior applications, including doors, windows, and wall panels. Dhabriya Polywood is based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

DHRUV.NS.d: Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited is an infrastructure consulting firm in India. It covers design, engineering, procurement, construction supervision and project management for highways, bridges, tunnels, buildings, environmental works and ports, and prepares detailed project reports and feasibility studies. It also supports operations and maintenance and acts as an independent or authority's engineer.

DIFFNKG.NS.d: Diffusion Engineers Limited develops and supplies industrial products, including welding materials, abrasion-resistant components and engineering apparatus, to industries in India and internationally. It also provides custom repair and refurbishment services for large machinery and equipment.

DOMS.NS.d: DOMS Industries Limited designs, develops, produces and distributes stationery internationally under its DOMS brand. Its portfolio includes writing and drawing essentials such as pencils, erasers, sharpeners and mathematical instrument sets, along with art products including chalk, crayons and oil pastels.

FEDFINA.NS.d: Fedbank Financial Services Limited is a non-banking finance company serving individuals and businesses in India through Distribution, Retail Finance and Wholesale Finance segments. It offers housing, car, personal, gold, SME and mortgage loans, construction finance for developers, loans to other NBFCs and insurance products. Incorporated in 1995, it is based in Mumbai.

FUSION.NS.d: Fusion Micro Finance Limited provides microfinance in India as a non-banking financial institution, mainly to women entrepreneurs in rural and semi-urban areas. Its products include business loans, both unsecured and secured, machinery financing and small collateral-free credit. Gurugram is its base, and it dates from 1994. It was formerly Fusion Microfinance Private Limited, renamed in July 2021.

GENCON.NS.d: Generic Engineering Construction and Projects Limited engages in the construction of residential buildings, commercial complexes, and other related activities in India. It offers general contracting services for civil and structural works; and internal infrastructure, such as roads, landscaping, etc., as well as provides specialized services for elevators, BMS, etc.

GKB.NS.d: GKB Ophthalmics Limited is an Indian company that manufactures and distributes ophthalmic lenses and frames. The company offers a wide range of eyewear products to meet the needs of its customers. Its headquarters are located in India.

GOCLCORP.NS.d: GOCL Corporation Limited engages in energetics and explosives, and property development businesses in India and internationally. Its Energetics and Explosives segment manufactures and markets corrosion resistant explobond clad plates, explobond electrical transition joints, explobond structural transition joints, and tubular transition joints, as well as explosively hardened CMS crossings and shovel teeth; and energetic materials, pyro devices, flexi severance cord systems, training devices, signaling devices,…

GODAVARIB.NS.d: Godavari Biorefineries Limited is an Indian company set up in Mumbai in 1939 that produces sugar and bio-based products. Its sugar range includes brown, plantation white and refined grades, and its distillery makes several grades of ethanol, including pharmaceutical and perfumery grades, plus rectified spirits.

GOLDTECH.NS.d: AION-TECH Solutions Limited provides information technology services, reporting in two segments: Information Technology and Software Services, and Software Licence. The company was established on 18 March 1994, and its main offices are in Hyderabad, India.

GRWRHITECH.NS.d: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited is a Mumbai-headquartered holding company founded in 1933 by Bhalchandra Digamber Garware. It makes polyester films, including coated label, thermal lamination, BOPP and BOPET products, and reports in India, China and rest-of-world geographic segments.

HBSL.NS.d: HB Stockholdings Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment and finance activities in India. It is involved in the investment, purchase, and sale of securities. The company was formerly known as HB Portfolio Leasing Limited and changed its name to HB Stockholdings Limited in February 1997. HB Stockholdings Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Gurugram, India.

HDBFS.NS.d: HDB Financial Services Ltd. provides loan products and insurance services through two segments: Lending and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO). The lending side finances retail customers buying items such as commercial equipment and vehicles, while the BPO side covers sales support, back-office and processing services.

HEXATRADEX.NS.d: Hexa Tradex Limited engages in the trading, and investment and financing businesses in India. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in New Delhi, India.

HINDADH.NS.d: Hindustan Adhesives Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing of pressure-sensitive self-adhesive tapes. The company manufactures tapes for various applications, including packaging, masking, and electrical insulation. Hindustan Adhesives Limited is based in Kolkata, India.

INDRAMEDCO.NS.d: Indraprastha Medical Corporation Limited provides hospital services in India. It offers services primarily in the areas of anesthesiology, advanced pediatrics, bone marrow transplant, cosmetic and plastic surgery, dental clinic, dermatology, elder care department, neonatology, general and advance laparoscopic surgery, pediatric urology and pediatric surgery, endocrinology, ear, nose, throat, fetal medicine, gastroenterology and GI surgery, gynecology and obstetrics, heart institutes, infertility care, critical…

JINDCOT.NS.d: Jindal Cotex Limited manufactures and sells yarns in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Textile and Energy Generation. The Textile segment produces and trades in acrylic, polyester, poly/cotton blended, cotton, and other blended yarns and knitted clothes. The Energy Generation segment is involved in the generation and sale of energy from the windmill. Jindal Cotex Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Ludhiana, India.

JISLDVREQS.NS.d: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited operates as a micro-irrigation company in India, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Hi-Tech Agri Input Products, Plastic, Agro Processing, and Other Business divisions. It provides drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, PE piping, and plumbing systems; and polyvinyl chloride pipes and pipe fittings, and EX-CEL plastic sheets.

JPASSOCIAT.NS.d: Jaiprakash Associates Limited operates as a diversified infrastructure conglomerate in India and internationally. The company operates through Construction, Cement & Cement Products, Hotel/Hospitality, Sports Events, Real Estate, Power, Infrastructure Projects, Investments, Fertilizers, Health Care, and Others segments.

MAITREYA.NS.d: Maitreya Medicare Ltd. is a healthcare provider operating a 125-bed multi-specialty hospital, Maitreya Multi-Specialty Hospital, in Surat, Gujarat. The company specializes in tertiary care, offering a broad spectrum of medical services across over 18 specialties and super-specialties. Key services include cardiology, oncology, critical care, urology, laparoscopic surgery, neurosurgery, spine surgery, nephrology, gastroenterology, and orthopedic surgery.

MARSHALL-SM.NS.d: Marshall Machines Limited is an Indian machine tool manufacturer specializing in CNC turning machines, vertical machining centers, and other specialized machines. The company caters to various industries, including automotive, aerospace, and general engineering. The company is based in Ludhiana, India.

MKEXIM.NS.d: M.K. Exim (India) Limited is an Indian textile company that manufactures and exports cotton yarns and fabrics. The company offers a range of textile products to customers worldwide. M.K. Exim (India) Limited is based in India.

MMFL.NS.d: M M Forgings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel forgings in India. The company offers steel forgings in raw, semi-machined, and fully machined stages in various grades of carbon, alloy, micro-alloy, and stainless steels. It also produces green energy from its solar and wind farms. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as The Madras Motors Ltd and changed its name to M M Forgings Limited in 1993.

MONTECARLO.NS.d: Monte Carlo Fashions Limited engages in manufacturing and trading woolen/cotton readymade apparels under the Monte Carlo brand primarily in India. The company provides shirts, trousers, denims, Bermudas, lowers, hi-street fashion shirts, tops, dresses, jumpsuits, urban tunics, shrugs, shorts, capris, narrow pants, leggings, track suits, T-shirts, ties, belts, and socks for men, women, and tweens. It also offers home furnishings and kids' apparel.

NITINFIRE.NS.d: Nitin Fire Protection Industries Limited manufactures and sells firefighting equipment under the NITIE brand in India and internationally. The company provides ABC, DCP, CO2, clean agent, foam, automatic modular, water, and K type fire extinguishers; gaseous fire suppression systems; kitchen fire suppression systems; fire detection and alarm systems; fire sprinkler systems; vehicle protection systems; fire pumps; foam equipment and compounds; wet and dry riser systems; emergency luminaires; and special hazards…

NOCIL.NS.d: NOCIL Limited manufactures and sells rubber chemicals in India. The company offers accelerators, anti-degradants, antioxidants, pre vulcanization inhibitors, and post vulcanization stabilizers. It serves tire and other rubber processing industries. The company also exports its products. NOCIL Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NURECA.NS.d: Nureca Limited, a B2C company, engages in the home healthcare and wellness products business primarily in India. It offers electric massagers, nebulizers, blood pressure monitors, glucometers, infrared thermometers for temperature scanning, fingertip pulse oximeters, weighing scales, home spa humidifiers and steamers, office electronics, rapid test kits, USB port car mobile chargers, and car mobile holder magnetic stands; and rehabilitation, mother and baby care, personal care and hygiene, nutrition, connected…

PDMJEPAPER.NS.d: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited manufactures and markets paper products in India. The company operates through Paper and Hygiene Products segments. It offers facial, napkin, bathroom/toilet, toweling, and diaper tissues; absorbent kraft, barrier, overlay, print base, and shuttering base paper products; bake oven, grease proof, grease proof slip easy, TDL poster, vegetable parchment, and wet strength grease proof paper products; Bible printing, medical, opaque laminating base (OLB) pharma, and yellow interleaving…

PFIZER.NS.d: Pfizer Limited manufactures, markets, trades in, and exports pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It offers its various products in various therapeutic areas, including anti-allergic, anti-diabetic, antihistamine, anti-infective, anti-parasitic, cardiovascular, dermatology, erectile dysfunction, neurology, pain/fever/inflammation, pediatrics, psychiatry, respiratory, urology, women's health, central nervous system, autoimmune disorders, and gastrointestinal.

POONAWALLA.NS.d: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited is an India-based non-banking financial institution offering asset-backed financial solutions. Its credit products include personal loans for salaried and public sector employees and for professionals like doctors, company secretaries and chartered accountants, covering needs such as home improvement, weddings and travel.

PRABHA.NS.d: Prabha Energy Ltd., set up in 2009, with its head office in Ahmedabad, operates in India's energy market, exploring for, producing and trading oil and natural gas from onshore assets in conventional and unconventional hydrocarbons. It also provides oil and gas related business services.

RPPL.NS.d: Rajshree Polypack Limited is an India-based maker and supplier of rigid plastic sheets and thermoformed packaging. Its products include tubs and containers for dairy items such as yogurt and ice cream, food and quick-service restaurant packaging, and single-use cups for juice, water, coffee and other beverages.

SAMBANDAM.NS.d: Sambandam Spinning Mills Limited is an India-based company engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling cotton yarn. The company produces various counts of yarn to serve different segments of the textile industry. It is headquartered in India.

SHAREINDIA.NS.d: Share India Securities Limited, a financial services company, trades in securities. The company offers broking/depository services, including equity, derivative, commodity, currency, mutual funds, and depository services; loan against securities, loan against commodities, business loans, and personal loans, as well as short, medium, and long term financial loans; and life and general insurances for individual and corporates.

SINDHUTRAD.NS.d: Sindhu Trade Links Limited, set up in Gurugram in 1992, operates businesses in India and abroad centred on transportation, loading and mining services. It went by the name Bhandari Consultancy and Finance Limited until June 2011, and reports in five segments, beginning with Transportation and Logistics.

SOUTHBANK.NS.d: The South Indian Bank Limited provides banking products and services in India. The company operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. Its personal banking products and services include savings accounts, term deposits, and unclaimed deposits/inoperative accounts; personal, car, home, gold, educational, property, and other loans, as well as one time settlement scheme for micro and small enterprises sector; and mutual funds.

SUNPHARMA.NS.d: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited, a generic pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and markets branded and generic formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India and internationally.

TARACHAND.NS.d: Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions Limited, founded in 1980 and headquartered in Chandigarh, India, provides logistics services across the country. Its business has three divisions: transportation and handling, equipment leasing, and steel processing and distribution. It owns a large fleet of specialized machinery, including many types of cranes, trailers and piling rigs.

TARIL.NS.d: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Limited (TRIL) and its affiliates make and sell transformers in India. Its products include power transformers for generators, auxiliary use, interconnection and railway trackside use, and rectifier transformers, for example units with 6 pulses or 12/24 pulses.

TINNARUBR.NS.d: Tinna Rubber & Infrastructure Ltd, established in 1977, makes high-value materials by reprocessing end-of-life tyres, in India and globally. Its products include crumb, micronised and coated rubber powders, reclaimed rubber, crumb rubber modifiers, polymer-modified bitumen and steel abrasives, used in road building and tyre and automotive manufacturing.

UNIENTER.NS.d: Uniphos Enterprises Limited engages in the trading of chemicals and other products in India. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Mumbai, India. Uniphos Enterprises Limited is a subsidiary of Nerka Chemicals Private Limited.

UNITECH.NS.d: Unitech Limited develops and leases real estate properties in India. The company develops commercial complexes, IT/ITes parks, SEZs, schools, hotels, malls, golf courses, and amusement parks. It also develops integrated residential projects, which include villas, apartments, offices, retail spaces, schools, clubs, floors, plots, and townships. In addition, the company leases IT/ITes and commercial office spaces; and provides property management and consultancy services.

UTLSOLAR.NS.d: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker UTLSOLAR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

VLSFINANCE.NS.d: VLS Finance Limited provides various financial services in India. The company's corporate consulting and advisory services include private placement of equities, debentures, and preference shares and bonds with banks, financial institutions, foreign institutional investors, mutual funds, corporates, and high net worth clients; advising on the structuring of schemes for raising debts in the form of fixed income securities; project reports, evaluations, and appraisals from financial institutions/banks; syndication…

YATHARTH.NS.d: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited, established in 2008 and based in Noida, India, runs super-specialty hospitals in Delhi and Madhya Pradesh. Its medical services include women's health, gastroenterology, pulmonology, pediatrics, nephrology and urology, cardiology, orthopedics, spine care and neurosciences, as well as general medicine and surgery.
